originalOwnerDecision.sourceJa: 電話では日時を聞き間違えそうです。窓口で返答を受け取り、日時を紙に書いていただきたいです。
originalOwnerDecision.target: ফোনে তারিখ ও সময় ভুল শুনতে পারি। কাউন্টারে উত্তর নিতে চাই এবং তারিখ ও সময় কাগজে লিখে দিতে অনুরোধ করব।
originalOwnerDecision.reason: Latest-main Bengali retains risk of mishearing date/time by phone, preference to receive the answer at the counter, and a request for the date/time to be written on paper. লিখে দিতে অনুরোধ করব clearly requests another person to write, avoiding the earlier speaker-role problem. Future request phrasing is compatible with the Japanese expressed wish; no repair is necessary.
originalOwnerDecision.scope: Single previously reviewed changed field only. Latest-main target is the exact string supplied by coordinator; local active checkout currently contains prior projected wording. No source or receipt edited.
